# ClankerKit

> Skills for agents that ship real software, with evidence receipts.

Install one skill with `npx skills add SlipstreamAI/ClankerKit --skill <name>`.
The machine-readable catalog is `catalog.json`.

## Skills

- [ci-failure-triage](https://github.com/SlipstreamAI/ClankerKit/blob/main/skills/ci-failure-triage/SKILL.md): Reads a failing CI log, separates infrastructure failures from product failures, and proposes the smallest fix. Use when a pull request or main branch check is red and the log is the evidence you have.
- [fix-flaky-test](https://github.com/SlipstreamAI/ClankerKit/blob/main/skills/fix-flaky-test/SKILL.md): Reproduces a flaky test, classifies the cause, and proves a de-flake with repeated runs. Use when a test fails intermittently and quarantine or a rerun is being treated as the fix.
- [trace-the-failure](https://github.com/SlipstreamAI/ClankerKit/blob/main/skills/trace-the-failure/SKILL.md): Reproduces a failure and traces it boundary by boundary until the cause is evidenced. Use when a bug, red test, or incident needs a deterministic repro before any fix.
- [dependency-upgrade](https://github.com/SlipstreamAI/ClankerKit/blob/main/skills/dependency-upgrade/SKILL.md): Plans and verifies a dependency bump, including majors, using the changelog and the project's tests. Use when upgrading a direct dependency, especially across a major version, and you need a rollback path.
- [deterministic-execution-lane](https://github.com/SlipstreamAI/ClankerKit/blob/main/skills/deterministic-execution-lane/SKILL.md): Runs a resumable, fail-closed implementation lane with explicit checkpoints. Use when a multi-step change must continue until done or blocked, without silent skips.
- [dockerize-and-deploy](https://github.com/SlipstreamAI/ClankerKit/blob/main/skills/dockerize-and-deploy/SKILL.md): Prepares a container build and deploy checklist with a smoke-test receipt. Use when adding a Dockerfile or shipping an image and you need build, run, and rollback evidence.
- [mcp-server-builder](https://github.com/SlipstreamAI/ClankerKit/blob/main/skills/mcp-server-builder/SKILL.md): Builds or changes an MCP server and proves a tool call against a local transport. Use when adding an MCP tool, resource, or prompt and you need a schema plus a real invocation receipt.
- [merge-train-governor](https://github.com/SlipstreamAI/ClankerKit/blob/main/skills/merge-train-governor/SKILL.md): Governs a single-lane merge queue with triage, readiness gates, and review hygiene. Use when several changes are competing to merge and promotion order must be explicit.
- [refactor-safely](https://github.com/SlipstreamAI/ClankerKit/blob/main/skills/refactor-safely/SKILL.md): Refactors code while pinning current behavior with characterization tests. Use when renaming, splitting, or moving code and the behavior must stay the same.
- [safe-pr-prep](https://github.com/SlipstreamAI/ClankerKit/blob/main/skills/safe-pr-prep/SKILL.md): Prepares a pull request with risk framing, proof receipts, and a reviewer-ready summary. Use when opening or updating a PR and the diff needs a claim-to-evidence handoff.
- [tdd-loop](https://github.com/SlipstreamAI/ClankerKit/blob/main/skills/tdd-loop/SKILL.md): Runs a red-green-refactor loop and records the command receipt for each step. Use when implementing a behavior and you want the test to fail for the right reason before production code changes.
- [docs-from-code](https://github.com/SlipstreamAI/ClankerKit/blob/main/skills/docs-from-code/SKILL.md): Updates README or API docs so the commands and interfaces match the code. Use when docs drift from flags, routes, or setup steps, or when a change needs docs that were verified by running them.
- [incident-postmortem](https://github.com/SlipstreamAI/ClankerKit/blob/main/skills/incident-postmortem/SKILL.md): Writes a blameless incident postmortem with a timeline, impact, and owned action items. Use when an incident is over or stable and the team needs a record that separates evidence from guesswork.
- [operator-handoff](https://github.com/SlipstreamAI/ClankerKit/blob/main/skills/operator-handoff/SKILL.md): Writes a handoff another human or agent can continue without hidden chat context. Use when work is pausing, swapping owners, or leaving a session that held the only copy of the plan.
- [release-notes-and-changelog](https://github.com/SlipstreamAI/ClankerKit/blob/main/skills/release-notes-and-changelog/SKILL.md): Drafts release notes and a changelog from merged commits or pull requests, and makes a semver call with reasons. Use when cutting a release or updating a changelog and the notes must match the history.
- [skill-creator](https://github.com/SlipstreamAI/ClankerKit/blob/main/skills/skill-creator/SKILL.md): Authors a new ClankerKit skill that follows the Agent Skills spec and the local evidence contract. Use when creating or reshaping a SKILL.md, including its frontmatter trigger, metadata, and handoff.
- [code-review](https://github.com/SlipstreamAI/ClankerKit/blob/main/skills/code-review/SKILL.md): Reviews a diff and returns severity-ranked findings tied to files and behavior. Use when a human or agent asks for a code review before merge and wants defects, risks, and missing tests rather than a style rewrite.
- [escalation-and-blockers](https://github.com/SlipstreamAI/ClankerKit/blob/main/skills/escalation-and-blockers/SKILL.md): Sets explicit escalation triggers, blocker definitions, and pause boundaries. Use when an agent must decide whether to continue, stop, or hand the work to a human.
- [gate-and-done](https://github.com/SlipstreamAI/ClankerKit/blob/main/skills/gate-and-done/SKILL.md): Defines the evidence contract, evaluates explicit merge or release gates, and checks definition-of-done across code, proof, docs, and handoff. Use when a change is called ready and reviewers need one pass or fail contract instead of separate evidence, gate, and done checks.
- [orchestrator-hardening](https://github.com/SlipstreamAI/ClankerKit/blob/main/skills/orchestrator-hardening/SKILL.md): Bootstraps a deterministic orchestration contract for lane routing, escalation, and stop boundaries. Use when an agent session needs capability routing, continuation rules, or a missing control loop in AGENTS.md.
- [skill-intake-gate](https://github.com/SlipstreamAI/ClankerKit/blob/main/skills/skill-intake-gate/SKILL.md): Screens a contributed skill for safety, determinism, and Agent Skills spec shape before acceptance. Use when reviewing a new or changed SKILL.md, helper script, or skill proposed for this catalog.
- [skill-security-scan](https://github.com/SlipstreamAI/ClankerKit/blob/main/skills/skill-security-scan/SKILL.md): Reviews a third-party skill directory for unsafe instructions and suspicious scripts before install. Use when adding a skill from outside this catalog, or when skill-intake-gate needs a file-level safety pass.
- [truth-recovery-program](https://github.com/SlipstreamAI/ClankerKit/blob/main/skills/truth-recovery-program/SKILL.md): Runs one parent audit of merged truth, intent drift, and queue quality. Use when history, open work, or prior merges can no longer be trusted at face value.
- [truthforge](https://github.com/SlipstreamAI/ClankerKit/blob/main/skills/truthforge/SKILL.md): Detects false-confidence tests, synthetic evidence, and completion claims that lack runtime-relevant proof. Use when a PR, incident, or agent says a runtime-visible change works or is done and the evidence may be mocked, shallow, or incomplete.
- [db-migration-safety](https://github.com/SlipstreamAI/ClankerKit/blob/main/skills/db-migration-safety/SKILL.md): Reviews a database migration for lock risk, expand-contract safety, and a reversible or forward-fix plan. Use when a pull request adds SQL or a migration framework change that alters tables, indexes, or backfills.
- [observability-add](https://github.com/SlipstreamAI/ClankerKit/blob/main/skills/observability-add/SKILL.md): Adds logs, metrics, or traces that answer a specific production question, without leaking secrets. Use when a feature is shipping and operators could not tell whether it worked or failed.
- [production-readiness-pass](https://github.com/SlipstreamAI/ClankerKit/blob/main/skills/production-readiness-pass/SKILL.md): Audits resilience, observability, rollback, and runtime assumptions before release. Use when a change is headed to production and operational failure modes are still unproven.
- [prompt-injection-hardening](https://github.com/SlipstreamAI/ClankerKit/blob/main/skills/prompt-injection-hardening/SKILL.md): Hardens features that pass untrusted text into an LLM by separating instructions from data and testing a benign injection fixture. Use when building or reviewing retrieval, email, ticket, or web content that a model will read.
- [secrets-and-config-audit](https://github.com/SlipstreamAI/ClankerKit/blob/main/skills/secrets-and-config-audit/SKILL.md): Audits environment variables, config files, and committed secrets against 12-factor hygiene. Use when reviewing how an app is configured, before deploy, or after a secret may have landed in a file.
- [security-review](https://github.com/SlipstreamAI/ClankerKit/blob/main/skills/security-review/SKILL.md): Reviews a diff for secrets, injection sinks, and missing authorization on new entrypoints. Use when a change touches auth, user input, queries, shell, files, deserialization, or dependencies and needs severity-ranked findings.
- [blast-radius-scan](https://github.com/SlipstreamAI/ClankerKit/blob/main/skills/blast-radius-scan/SKILL.md): Estimates change impact across code, runtime boundaries, and operational workflows. Use when a diff looks small but shared types, config, or data paths may spread the effect.
- [find-the-real-entrypoints](https://github.com/SlipstreamAI/ClankerKit/blob/main/skills/find-the-real-entrypoints/SKILL.md): Separates true runtime entrypoints from scaffolds, demos, and tests. Use when you need the path a real user, job, or caller hits before changing behavior.
- [legacy-code-archaeology](https://github.com/SlipstreamAI/ClankerKit/blob/main/skills/legacy-code-archaeology/SKILL.md): Recovers the intent of legacy code from git history, callers, and tests. Use when you must change old code and the reason it exists is not in the current comments.
- [map-the-system](https://github.com/SlipstreamAI/ClankerKit/blob/main/skills/map-the-system/SKILL.md): Maps entrypoints, boundaries, dependencies, and blast radius before broad edits. Use when the repo is unfamiliar or a change could cross service, package, or runtime boundaries.
- [onboard-to-repo](https://github.com/SlipstreamAI/ClankerKit/blob/main/skills/onboard-to-repo/SKILL.md): Produces a first-hour orientation of a repository: how it starts, how it is tested, and which entrypoints are real. Use when an agent or human is new to a repo and needs a map before editing.
- [accessibility-audit](https://github.com/SlipstreamAI/ClankerKit/blob/main/skills/accessibility-audit/SKILL.md): Audits a UI change against keyboard, name, contrast, and error-state checks with evidence. Use when a screen changes and someone needs a WCAG-oriented pass that says what was actually exercised.
- [agent-eval-harness](https://github.com/SlipstreamAI/ClankerKit/blob/main/skills/agent-eval-harness/SKILL.md): Sets up an evaluation harness for an agent or LLM feature with explicit cases and graders. Use when an agent prompt, tool, or model change needs a repeatable pass rate instead of a single impressive example.
- [api-contract-check](https://github.com/SlipstreamAI/ClankerKit/blob/main/skills/api-contract-check/SKILL.md): Compares an API or schema change with its consumers and flags breaking changes. Use when a pull request changes request or response shapes, status codes, OpenAPI, protobuf, or shared types.
- [evidence-research-flywheel](https://github.com/SlipstreamAI/ClankerKit/blob/main/skills/evidence-research-flywheel/SKILL.md): Turns research into confidence-scored claims while keeping sources attached. Use when gathering repo or external evidence and handing off a bounded plan without dropping provenance.
- [frontend-ui-verify](https://github.com/SlipstreamAI/ClankerKit/blob/main/skills/frontend-ui-verify/SKILL.md): Verifies a user-visible UI change by exercising the flow and recording screenshot or trace evidence. Use when a pull request claims a screen, component, or interaction changed and unit tests are the only proof.
- [performance-profile](https://github.com/SlipstreamAI/ClankerKit/blob/main/skills/performance-profile/SKILL.md): Measures a performance claim before and after a change, using the same workload. Use when someone wants a speed or cost improvement and the only evidence so far is a feeling or a single anecdote.
- [runtime-proof](https://github.com/SlipstreamAI/ClankerKit/blob/main/skills/runtime-proof/SKILL.md): Tests whether a runtime-visible claim is proven by runtime-relevant evidence instead of a synthetic harness. Use when a fix, feature, or deploy claim depends on real execution and a green suite is the only receipt offered.
- [test-surface-skeptic](https://github.com/SlipstreamAI/ClankerKit/blob/main/skills/test-surface-skeptic/SKILL.md): Judges whether tests prove behavior on real risk surfaces or only the shape of a harness. Use when coverage looks broad but the assertions may be mocks, snapshots, or tautologies.
- [write-real-tests](https://github.com/SlipstreamAI/ClankerKit/blob/main/skills/write-real-tests/SKILL.md): Adds behavior tests that fail for a real reason before the fix and pass after it. Use when a change needs coverage that proves behavior, especially when existing tests only assert mocks, snapshots, or implementation details.

## Bundles

- full-catalog: Every ClankerKit skill. Prefer a smaller bundle unless you want the whole catalog installed. Skills: accessibility-audit, agent-eval-harness, api-contract-check, blast-radius-scan, ci-failure-triage, code-review, db-migration-safety, dependency-upgrade, deterministic-execution-lane, dockerize-and-deploy, docs-from-code, escalation-and-blockers, evidence-research-flywheel, find-the-real-entrypoints, fix-flaky-test, frontend-ui-verify, gate-and-done, incident-postmortem, legacy-code-archaeology, map-the-system, mcp-server-builder, merge-train-governor, observability-add, onboard-to-repo, operator-handoff, orchestrator-hardening, performance-profile, production-readiness-pass, prompt-injection-hardening, refactor-safely, release-notes-and-changelog, runtime-proof, safe-pr-prep, secrets-and-config-audit, security-review, skill-creator, skill-intake-gate, skill-security-scan, tdd-loop, test-surface-skeptic, trace-the-failure, truth-recovery-program, truthforge, write-real-tests.
- incident: Trace a failure, separate synthetic green from runtime truth, and leave a blameless handoff. Skills: trace-the-failure, truthforge, escalation-and-blockers, production-readiness-pass, incident-postmortem, observability-add.
- new-repo-onboarding: Spend the first hour mapping how a repository actually runs before editing it. Skills: onboard-to-repo, map-the-system, find-the-real-entrypoints, blast-radius-scan, legacy-code-archaeology.
- pr-safety: Review a pull request with risk framing, an evidence gate, runtime proof, and ranked findings. Skills: safe-pr-prep, gate-and-done, runtime-proof, truthforge, code-review, test-surface-skeptic, blast-radius-scan.
- security: Review diffs, config, untrusted model input, and third-party skills before they ship. Skills: security-review, secrets-and-config-audit, prompt-injection-hardening, skill-security-scan, skill-intake-gate.
- ship: Upgrade, migrate, containerize, and explain a release with receipts instead of a vibe. Skills: dependency-upgrade, refactor-safely, ci-failure-triage, dockerize-and-deploy, release-notes-and-changelog, db-migration-safety, api-contract-check, docs-from-code.
- testing: Add behavior tests, run a red-green loop, and challenge coverage that does not prove the claim. Skills: write-real-tests, tdd-loop, fix-flaky-test, test-surface-skeptic, runtime-proof, frontend-ui-verify.
